title: Change the HIN certificate details for a vessel
summary: Learn how to amend the details on a vessel's Hull Identification Number (HIN) certificate.
intro:
The Hull Identification Number (HIN) is the unique identifier for a boat. When a vessel is registered, it requires a HIN certificate, which lists important vessel details.

If details on the original (blue certificate) or copy (pink certificate) of the HIN certificate need to be amended, you must obtain a 'Modification Certificate' from a Boatcode Agent.

The Boatcode Agent will inspect the vessel and issue you the Modification Certificate. In addition, you will need to complete the Application for HIN (Boatcode) form that the agent will give you.

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required documentation and completed forms from the Boatcode Agent.
Visit a service centre and provide the information in person, or mail to:

faqs.q: What is the Hull Identification Number (HIN)?
faqs.a: The HIN is the unique identifier for a boat.

faqs.q: Who can help me amend my HIN certificate details?
faqs.a: You must obtain a 'Modification Certificate' from a Boatcode Agent.

faqs.q: What do I need to do to change my HIN details?
faqs.a: The Boatcode Agent will inspect the vessel and issue the Modification Certificate. You must also complete the Application for HIN (Boatcode) form provided by the agent.
